title: Wonders
description: A mod that adds new discoveries, small vanilla expansions, atmospheric details, and new items that aren't big enough for their own mods.
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f82e95b1783f0af659113cf43f5bc5c6c71fc36.png)

Wonders is a mod which adds new vanilla-inspired features that are too small to get their own specialized mod. Instead of revamping or redesigning older features, Wonders tries to applify the more unseen parts of vanilla with new additions to make them feel more completely.

### Golden Carrot on a Stick
- Craftable with a Fishing Rod & a Golden Carrot.
- Interact with while on a pig to active a "Superboost".
- Activate both boosts for a new configurable ability.

### Glow Torch
- A new torch variant craftable with Glow Inc Sacs
- These are now placeable underwater

### White Cherry 
- White Cherry trees can be found within Cherry Groves
- Also spawns with the new tilable flower block, Minty Petals
- White Cherry Leaves drop the new White Cherry saplings

### Cave Vine Growth
- A new lush cave block that is placeable on all surfaces
- Can be bonemealed to harvest Glowberries
- Craftable with 1 Glowberry & 1 Vine

### Ossified Sculk
- A new bone block obtainable in Ancient Cities chests
- Can be grown with a Sculk Catalyst
- Stonecuttable into the new Ossified Sculk Spine

Additionally there are many QOL recipe changes, check changelogs to see the full list!

# QNA

A quick questionaire and explaination for some stuff regarding this mod and others. 

**Q: How can I tell you guys if there are any bugs?**

A: The link to our discord is right on this page, just join and contact one of us and let us know. We want to make sure our mods are bug-free.

**Q: Am I good to add or show this in my modpack/video?**

A: 100%, you don't need permission either, the only ask is that when our mod is included in a video that we are credited or a link to the mod is provided.

**Q: I have a really cool idea! Can I suggest it as a feature for this mod?**

A: Of course! Inside the discord, we have an alloted channel for suggesting new ideas for GLYPH projects. Feel free to follow the format and suggest a new concept! We will credit any suggestions that make it into the mod in the changelogs and in the credits for the mod.
